title: Cascade Vision Professional Fee Schedule — Routine Eye Exam Fee by Network Channel
content:
On the Vision Plans, the scheduled fee for the routine eye exam of an exam visit follows the visit's network channel, which is read from the claim lines.

| Network channel of the visit | Scheduled exam fee |
|---|---|
| Participating retail-chain location | 95.00 |
| Provider without a Cascade agreement (out of network) | The plan's out-of-network exam amount |
| Participating independent practice | 110.00 |

The out-of-network exam amount for each plan is:

| Plan | Out-of-network exam amount |
|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 40.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 45.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 45.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 60.00 |

**Schedule notes**

- The channel is the one recorded on the visit's lines. It is fixed by the provider's agreement in force on the date of service: a retail-chain location under a Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement, an independent practice under such an agreement, or out of network.
- The three rows are exhaustive: every exam visit falls in exactly one channel.

*Hypothetical comparison.* A Cascade Vision Select 150 member's exam visit has a scheduled exam fee of 95.00 at a retail-chain location, 110.00 at an independent practice, and 50.00 out of network.
